description: Find project items (Edit > Find) by part of their name, part of their media file path, kind, or whether their media is offline, in the whole project or one bin. Returns ids and bin paths as list_project_items does, with the media path and offline state when those were searched

bin.description: Search inside this bin. Default: the whole project

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

limit.description: At most this many items. Default 500

mediaPath.description: Text the media file path contains (any case); only clips match

name.description: Text the item name contains (any case)

offline.description: true: only clips whose media is offline; false: only online clips

name: search_project_items
title: Search Project Items
